name: Global Prime Factorization Constraint
description: Replaces the local per-edge equality with a global product equation over all edges. By requiring the product of (s_u + s_v) to equal 3^m, unique prime factorization strictly forces every edge sum to be 3. This removes the local "for each link" affordance, forcing the model to deduce the local constraint via number theory before it can recognize the bipartite structure.
